sections.title: Emergency Notice
lines: If this is a medical emergency, hang up and dial 911 or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.

sections.title: Urgency Screening
lines: Ask whether the patient has new flashes or floaters.
Ask how long the symptom has been present.
Ask whether there is sudden or gradual vision loss.
New flashes or floaters should be treated as urgent and offered the next available appointment.

sections.title: Location and Contact
lines: Practice name: Eye Radiance.
Address: 1100 N Lyle Avenue, Crystal River, FL 34429.
Email: newpatient@abitaeye.com.

sections.title: Hours
lines: Hours are Tuesday through Thursday, 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
The office is closed Monday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

sections.title: Other Location
lines: The other location is Abita Eye Group in Spring Hill at 10495 SpringHill Drive, Springhill, FL 34608.
Spring Hill is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM.
Spring Hill sees Dr. Bach, Dr. Noel, and Dr. Licht.

sections.title: Practice Scope
lines: This is an ophthalmology practice, not optometry.
Crystal River sees medical eye conditions such as glaucoma, eyelid concerns, and flashes or floaters.
The office does not perform routine eye exams or vision-only checkups.

sections.title: Pediatric Visits
lines: Crystal River does not see pediatric ophthalmology.
For pediatric visits, schedule the patient at Spring Hill.

sections.title: Cataract Evaluations
lines: Crystal River does not schedule cataract evaluations or cataract surgery workups there.
For cataract-related visits, schedule the patient at Spring Hill.

sections.title: Routine Eye Exams and Glasses Prescriptions
lines: Crystal River does not perform routine eye exams or vision-only checkups.
If the caller wants a routine eye exam or glasses prescription, schedule the patient at Spring Hill or with an optometrist.

sections.title: Medical Eye Conditions
lines: Crystal River sees medical eye conditions such as glaucoma, eyelid concerns, and flashes or floaters.

sections.title: Providers
lines: Dr. Licht (pronounced Likt, NPI 14-97147680) practices at Crystal River.
He handles comprehensive ophthalmology, oculoplastic eyelid surgery, and glaucoma.
If speech recognition produces Lee, Licked, Lit, Lisht, Lich, Lish, or Liked, treat that as Dr. Licht.

sections.title: Glasses Warranty or Broken Glasses
lines: If a patient asks about warranty or broken glasses, have them bring the glasses into the Spring Hill location.
Spring Hill staff will review the glasses and determine the available options in person.

sections.title: Insurance and Referrals
lines: The practice works with most major insurance plans.
Referral requirements depend on the patient's insurance policy.
Insurance verification may be required before appointment confirmation.

sections.title: What to Bring
lines: Patients should bring a photo ID, insurance card, list of current medications, and previous eye records if available.

sections.title: Appointment Expectations
lines: New patient visits may take 1 to 2 hours depending on testing.
Eye dilation may occur during the visit and can temporarily cause blurry vision and light sensitivity.
The practice typically sends an email confirmation after scheduling.
Visit costs vary based on insurance and appointment type, and coverage details are determined after insurance verification.

sections.title: Scope Limitation
lines: This knowledge base provides general practice information only.
It does not provide diagnosis, medical advice, or treatment recommendations.
Medical decisions must be made by a licensed physician during an in-person evaluation.
